data.title: [Incident (Recovered)] Anomaly in Realtime Compute for Apache Flink Management Service in China (Hangzhou) and China (Shanghai) Regions

eventUpdates.content: At 16:25 Beijing time, the Flink Console management service in the China (Hangzhou) and China (Shanghai) regions has been recovered. The monitoring displays and alert notifications for the affected Cloud Database and Cloud Network products have also been recovered.

Dear Customer,

Starting from 15:13 Beijing time on April 20, 2026, Alibaba Cloud Monitoring detected anomalies in Flink Console access and OpenAPI calls in the China (Hangzhou) and China (Shanghai) regions (job execution was not affected). As a result, monitoring displays and alert notifications for some Cloud Database and Cloud Network products were also affected (instance operation was not affected). Alibaba Cloud engineers are urgently handling the incident. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at any time.
